test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Cricket : Pitch :: Badminton : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :

__
 
• The area where **cricket** is played is called **pitch**.

Similarly,

 
• The area where **badminton** is played is called **court**.

Hence, **"Court"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Track ⇒ The area where athletics is played is called track.
 
• Field ⇒ The area where various sports takes place.
 
• Pool ⇒ The area where swimming is done is called pool.
